interface: 0-1 V AC into biased SIM4 ADC; firmware samples ~1 kHz and reports RMS once per second

measurands.name: load_current_rms_a
measurands.accuracy: ~1-2% mid-range; unreliable below ~0.05 A; ~24 mA floor unassisted

acceptance_test: clamp on a known resistive load (kettle); reading must match P/230 within ±10% before data collection begins; record result via annotate
failure_modes: systematic underreading: jaw not fully closed; a gap invisible to the eye can halve the reading and it stays plausible-looking
near-zero on a live circuit: clamped around live+neutral together (flux cancels), clamp one conductor only
baseline sag over weeks at constant load: spring fatigue, re-seat the jaw
mounting: single conductor through the jaw; secure the CT body so cable movement cannot work the jaw open
